# gitea_org_actions_variable (Resource)

`gitea_org_actions_variable` manages an organisation-scoped Actions variable.

Import expects the resource ID in the form `org:variable_name`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org` (String) The organisation owning the Actions variable.
- `value` (String) The Actions variable value.
- `variable_name` (String) The Actions variable name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The Actions variable description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
